name: Initiative
description: Initiative is a shared workspace for communities, with tasks, projects, documents, calendars and dashboards. Live collaboration and configurable permissions let a household or team organize its work in one place.

notes.text: Open https://CONTAINER-IP and accept the self-signed certificate. Create your first account immediately: it becomes the owner; subsequent public registration is disabled.
After an IP or domain change, update APP_URL in /etc/initiative/server.env and restart initiative-server. Use a trusted HTTPS reverse proxy for a public domain.
